documents.text:
Zero Point Voltage (ZPM) is the seventh electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. This tier is largely centered around building the infrastructure necessary to construct the next tier of Fusion Reactor, which is necessary for progression into UV. In addition, this tier introduces TecTech, the source of many late game multi-blocks. It also sees additional power generation with the availability of the Large Naquadah Reactor and MK2 Fusion Controller, and a new source of resources in the Void Miner . However, similar to LuV, material costs and processing requirements continue to rise and so infrastructure such as a Mega Electric Blast Furnace , Mega Vacuum Freezer , and Mega Chemical Reactor may be necessary. Circuits get a major improvement with the addition of Europium-doped wafers. The PCB Factory is also build-able at this stage, though its quest is UV. ZPM is generally considered to mark the transition from midgame to lategame.
Progression
Waterline
New water grades for the Waterline are now mandatory to cut and use Europium doped wafers. These wafers can be used to improve circuit production, but their main use is for ZPM Energy Hatches and Dynamo Hatches, which require NPIC wafers that can only be made from Europium or better wafers. Grade 3 water is the minimum needed, though grade 4 provides a speed boost, and will be required in UV as an ingredient in grade 5.
Naquadah Line
Although the Naquadah portion of the Naqline was already required in LuV, the portions for Enriched Naquadah and Naquadria become required in ZPM. Both are significantly shorter than the Naquadah portion; combined, they have roughly the same number of steps as Naquadah does. The full Naqline is required to progress further into ZPM, as both Enriched Naquadah and Naquadria are used to make the HIP Unit. These portions also have useful byproducts: Enriched Naquadah yields Trinium, and Naquadria produces Indium.
Hot Isostatic Pressurization Unit
A HIP Unit.
The Hot Isostatic Pressurization Unit (HIP Unit) is an upgraded version of the Large Electric Compressor that is both unlocked and required in ZPM. It can run regular Compressor recipes quicker and more efficiently, and it has the ability to make Superdense Plates from most materials, which are required in many recipes in ZPM and onwards, such as the Fusion Reactor Mk2. However, it is more challenging to automate, as it heats up while running, and if it overheats it becomes far slower and will void recipes that require the HIP Unit.
Fusion Reactor Mk2
A Mk2 Fusion Reactor.
The Fusion Reactor Mk2 becomes available when the player is able to make Superdense Plates and ZPM Energy Hatches. It is also the final goal of ZPM, as it is required to make Americium, which is needed in large quantities for UV components. In addition to the new recipes they have available, Mk2 fusion reactors can also run Mk1 recipes, which will result in a "fusion overclock", which uses twice the EU/t and works twice as fast.
Americium
Americium is incredibly slow in the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, taking 43.2 seconds per ingot and 34 minutes for enough ingots for a single UV Electric Motor. It is much slower than Europium: it takes three times as long to produce, and twice as much is used in each motor. Methods for dealing with this include making it passively, either in multiple reactors or over many days on a server, or even making a Compact Fusion Reactor for players whose infrastructure, resources, and power can support it. In UV, many better methods of making Americium will become available, including the Americium Bee in a Mega Apiary , a Meteor containing thousands of Americium Dust worth of ore, and a much faster recipe in the Mk3 Fusion Reactor; however, all of them require large amounts of Americium to reach.
Lutetium
Americium also requires Lutetium, a metal which cannot be found as an ore naturally. Methods for obtaining Lutetium at this point include:
- Processing Monazite Ore through the Milling Line
- Cracking and distilling Heavy Naquadah Fuel, which is part of the Naquadah Fuel production line
- Processing Thorium in the High Temperature Gas-Cooled Reactor
- Using the meteor summoned by the ZPM Circuit Assembler
- Using the Lutetium Bee
- Processing Depleted Thorium Fuel Rods from a Nuclear Reactor
- Replicating it from UU-Matter
Other Fusion Recipes
Other notable recipes unlocked by the Mk2 Fusion Reactor are:
- Tritanium is produced from Duranium and Titanium. In ZPM its main use is as a gate for Void Miners and the Tier 6 Rocket, but in UV and UHV it begins to see many more uses for circuits, superconductors, Energy Hatches, and more.
- Naquadah Based Liquid Fuel MkI is the first step in the Naquadah Fuels, which can be burned for immense amounts of power in a Large Naquadah Reactor .
- Tin Plasma is a step up from Helium Plasma in conventional plasma power generation, and Zinc Plasma, Niobium Plasma, Krypton Plasma, Astral Titanium Plasma, and Runite Plasma are new steps in the "plasma chain" of advanced plasma fuels.
- Nitrogen Plasma is used in the Beam Line and the Plasma Arc Furnace.
- Zinc Plasma, Oxygen Plasma, and Titanium Plasma have some uses in UV or UHV, but none are relevant enough to make them worth producing in ZPM.
- Tungsten, Iridium, Naquadah, and Uranium 238 can all be produced via fusion, although none of these recipes are generally useful due to how slow they are in comparison to conventional methods.
- Excited Uranium and Plutonium liquid fuels can be made with fusion, but the Neutron Activator recipe is much faster and cheaper and should always be used instead.
Tier 6 Rocket
The Tier 6 Rocket can be crafted once a Mk2 Fusion Reactor has been used to produce Tritanium, which is needed for the Tier 6 Heavy Duty Plate. There are two planets available, Proteus and Triton, both moons of Neptune. They contain a few new ores, most notably Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Plutonium 241, Uranium 235, Niobium, and Yttrium, which can be harvested either with conventional Ore Drilling Plants or with Void Miners . Deuterium and Ethylene are available as underground fluids from a Fluid Drilling Rig . The Tier 6 Rocket also unlocks the ability to make Planetary Gas Siphons above Neptune for Tritium, Helium-3, Ammonia, and Xenon.
Infrastructure Improvements
Power Generation
In ZPM, most existing power generation methods from earlier tiers, such as Nitrobenzene , Rocket Fuel, and Nuclear Reactors , remain viable, but start to fall off due to increasing power demands and a lack of upgrades. One notable upgrade is Huge Turbines for all gas, steam, or plasma-based power, which are unlocked with Americium.
Plasma, on the other hand, is still viable and will continue to be viable for many more tiers. In addition to the aforementioned Huge Turbines, plasma benefits from better fuels in the form of Tin Plasma or Runite Plasma (although the latter requires a UV Alloy Blast Smelter ), better production rates using the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, and the XL Plasma Turbine and XL Supercritical Steam Turbine to greatly improve power throughput.
A Large Naquadah Reactor.
ZPM also unlocks one of the strongest power generation methods in the mid and late game: Naquadah Fuel, often abbreviated to Naqfuel. Power is produced by inputting Naqfuel into a Large Naquadah Reactor (LNR), alongside Liquid Air, a coolant (Gelid Cryotheum), and an excited liquid (Molten Atomic Separation Catalyst), all of which will need to be produced in large quantities by players seeking to use the fuel for power. Two tiers of Naqfuel are available in ZPM: tier 1 requires the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, while tier 2 is produced by combining tier 1 fuel with a couple other ingredients in an overclocked Mega Chemical Reactor . Each LNR can generate up to 42.9M EU/t with Naqfuel 1, and up to 101.2M EU/t with Naqfuel 2.
Lasers
Lasers are a new way to distribute power that are much better than cables on throughput, flexibility, and expandability, at the cost of being more expensive to make. Lasers are started by Laser Source Hatches on multiblocks that accept them (including the Lapotronic Supercapacitor and most advanced generators), moved by Laser Vacuum Pipes, and received by Laser Target Hatches. Most multiblocks do not accept laser power directly, so Active Transformers (ATs) are required in order to transform it into conventional power closer to where machines are located; ATs are also the only way to split, merge, or bend lasers in ZPM. UV unlocks the Laser Vacuum Mirror, which can bend lasers without needing an AT, but not split or merge them. A laser-based power grid is not necessary in ZPM, but will be required by UHV to feasibly transport the immense amount of power used in later tiers.
Data Bank and Assembly Lines
A Data Bank.
The Data Bank is a TecTech multiblock that can be used to store large quantities of Data Sticks for the Assembly Line , as well as to spread the same Data Sticks between many different Assembly Lines. The latter capability can be used to relatively easily add new Assembly Lines or Advanced Assembly Lines to speed up slower recipes that are needed in large quantities, such as LuV and ZPM components like motors and pumps.
Void Miners
Void Miners (VMs) are a new way to collect ore that become available once a Mk2 Fusion Reactor is used to produce Tritanium. They resemble Ore Drilling Plants , but unlike those they do not actually take ore from the world: instead, they generate infinite amounts of ore based on the dimension they are built in, making them extremely useful as a passive source of most resources in the game. Players unlocking VMs should be cautious that they will produce far more ore than anything before them, so a robust ore processing system is necessary to avoid being overwhelmed by unprocessed ore; even Meteors will not strain an ore processing system as much as VMs do, since VMs produce ore constantly.
Toxic Everglades
The Toxic Everglades can be visited by making a portal out of Containment Frames and lighting it with an Alkalus Disk, which requires a ZPM Alloy Blast Smelter to make. On versions prior to 2.9 the dimension has a unique method of ore generation that was different from vanilla and GT. This makes regular prospecting and mining less predictable, although the Electric Prospector's Scanner is capable of highlighting veins as they appear. Notably, the Toxic Everglades features a large amount of GT++ ores, many of which produce rare earths as well as on-tier materials such as Europium when processed. By placing a Void Miner, all of these rare materials can be harvested easily.
Neutronium
Neutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck.
Noble Gases
Both smelting (including Neutronium smelting) and Void Miners can be vastly improved by using a high-tier noble gas. Oganesson is not practically obtainable in ZPM, but the next steps down, Xenon and Krypton, are. There are two methods of obtaining these gases: their respective bees or the Planetary Gas Siphon (PGS). The PGS is best used for Xenon, which requires a Tier 6 Rocket; each PGS can collect 350 L/s of Xenon when fed with 2A of ZPM. Bees are much more efficient on power, but the Xenon Bee cannot be used yet because it requires the Mega Apiary , meaning Krypton is the best noble gas available from bees in ZPM.
UU-Matter
UU-Matter begins to see significant use in UV as a crafting component, particularly for circuits, in addition to its existing use in replicating elements. Because of this fact and how slow UU-Matter is to make, it's recommended to set up a singleblock Mass Fabricator to produce UU-Matter passively in order to prepare for UV, although it is also possible to make the Matter Fabrication CPU in ZPM by overclocking some machines and obtaining a Quantum Anomaly.
Sidequests
Wetware Circuits
Wetwares are the next circuit line after Crystal Circuits, spanning from LuV to UHV. The first three of them can be made in ZPM, but the fourth requires UV in order to make the Research Station for the Assembly Line Data Stick; this is the start of a pattern that will continue until the endgame of only being able to make circuits one tier up, rather than two as has been the case since HV. It is possible to replace Crystals with Wetwares for LuV to UV, but this is not recommended, as Wetwares are much slower and much more expensive than their same-tier Crystal counterparts.
Other Multiblocks
- PCB Factory : The PCB Factory is a multiblock that can produce circuit boards much cheaper than the Large Chemical Reactor ; it is especially useful for the expensive Wetware boards. However, it is unable to run any overclocks or parallels at all until UHV, or UV with meteors, which makes it impractically slow to use in ZPM, although Wetwares are expensive enough to potentially justify it.
- Large Scale Auto-Assembler v1.01 : This multiblock, also known as the LSAA, as a multiblock assembler. While it has many fewer parallels than the Precise Auto-Assembler , it can be tier skipped with additional energy. So the LSAA should be built prior to entering UV to act as a faster UV assembler before obtaining a UV energy hatch. A similar case happens in UHV, where a UHV assembler is needed before the energy hatch can be obtained, so the LSAA will also be useful.
- Energy Infuser : The Energy Infuser is a TecTech multiblock that can be used to charge electric GregTech items extremely quickly, as well as repair most items using UU-Matter.
Beam Line
The Beam Line is an optional line that can be used instead of the Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver to engrave wafers for circuits. It is significantly cheaper on resources and can be scaled much more easily, but is very expensive initially and much more complex to get working.
Zero Point Module Quests
There is an optional quest line in ZPM to obtain a filled Zero Point Module item, which is a ZPM battery that can produce one amp of ZPM for 8.8 days of real-life time. In order to reach it, the player needs to complete four hidden quests. Each quest will be revealed when the player holds at least one of its required item, and consumes some amount of that item to complete. The required items for the hidden quests are:
- 1 Singularity (from AE2)
- 4 Shard of Creation
- 8 Life Shard and 8 Soul Shard
- 32 Unknown Crystal Shard
The quest line also requires a few foods from Pam's HarvestCraft, and a few cheap GT items.

documents.text:
Ultimate Voltage (UV) is the eighth electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. It is largely centered around the new Wetware circuit line, which introduces new multiblocks like the Quantum Computer and Research Station , as well a-s the new technologies that are unlocked with them, like the third tier of Fusion Reactor . It also introduces many multiblocks for improving infrastructure, including the Mega Alloy Blast Smelter , Component Assembly Line , and Space Elevator , as well as key automation tools like the Stocking Input Hatch.
Progression
Tier 7 Rocket
The Tier 7 Rocket is available as soon as the player is able to power their Assembly Line with two UV Energy Hatches to overclock it to UHV. It unlocks four new planets: Haumea, Makemake, Pluto, and the Kuiper Belt, which should only be mined using Void Miners at this point. The most useful planet to mine is Haumea, which has the earliest source of Nether Star Ore as well as a high chance for Infused Gold Ore, making it very useful for setting up the second tier of Naquadah Fuel. Other new ores are Borax, Red Garnet, Yellow Garnet, and Chrysotile. The available underground fluids are Hydrofluoric Acid on Makemake, and Oxygen, Nitrogen, Fluorine, and Liquid Air on Pluto.
The dungeons containing the next tier of schematic are found on Pluto, alongside the Draconic Core Schematic for the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter . It is highly recommended to place the Tier 8 Rocket Schematic in a singleblock Scanner (a Research Station in Scanner mode will not work) and duplicate it using a UV Circuit Assembler, because two Tier 8 Rocket Schematics will be needed: one for making the Tier 8 Rocket, and one to be researched for the Shuttle Schematic for the Mothership .
Wetware Circuits
Wetwares are the UV circuit line, spanning from LuV to UHV, which are required for advanced UV components and machines and will be used in UHV as an on-tier circuit. Wetwares are the first circuits that require the Assembly Line to produce, using it for the Neuro Processing Units that are required for the first circuit, the Wetwareprocessor. In addition, all UHV and above circuits, of which the Wetware Mainframe is the first, must be made in the Assembly Line and do not have Circuit Assembly Line recipes. The Advanced Assembly Line is highly recommended in order to produce these circuits faster. The Wetware Mainframe is also the first recipe to require the Research Station in order to obtain its Data Stick instead of the Scanner.
A Bacterial Vat, needed for Wetware circuits.
They are also the first required use of the Bacterial Vat , in order to make the Raw Growth Catalyst Medium for many different components of the circuits. This multiblock has a unique mechanic where the Output Hatch must be kept half full in order to maximize production speed and minimize item inputs. It also requires the use of the singleblock Bio Lab to produce cultures, which must be inserted into the controller for each Bacterial Vat. Note that many Bio Lab recipes require the items to be placed in the exact slot shown on NEI, unlike other singleblock machines. The necessary cultures for Raw Growth Catalyst Medium are easy to produce in sufficient quantities, but later cultures will be much more complex.
There are three different recipes for Raw Growth Catalyst Medium. The Mutagen recipe is the best for any players with sufficient bee breeding progress to access the Mutagen Producer, which can and should be accelerated with a World Accelerator , since it is the cheapest on item inputs and using it cuts out previous Bacterial Vat or Big Barrel Brewery steps. Otherwise, the three recipes are equally fast when accounting for their different voltages, and the decision of which to use is largely determined by which input fluid is easiest to obtain.
Because Wetwares rely on slower machines such as the Bacterial Vat and Assembly Line , in addition to having slower recipes in the Circuit Assembly Line , most players opt to continue using Crystals for LuV through UV circuits, and relegate Wetwares to only being used for UHV circuits.
PCB Factory
The PCB Factory is unlocked with Wetware Circuit Boards, and can be immediately upgraded with the Biochamber to be able to make said boards. With the upgrades available in UV, it is unable to overclock or parallel at all, even imperfectly. This makes it extremely slow, but it is still far cheaper than the standard Large Chemical Reactor recipes, making it a valuable upgrade for the expensive Wetware boards.
Research Station
A Research Station with a pair of Quantum Computers.
The Research Station is a new multiblock that replaces the Scanner for most Assembly Line recipe scans from UV onwards. Each Research Station recipe has a minimum computation rate in order to run at all, in addition to a total computation requirement to complete the research; most relevant recipes will have low computation rate requirements for a while, but building more computation than strictly necessary will make researching much faster. Each recipe also consumes varying amounts of EU/t, so more computation will save power by not having to draw that power for as long. The Research Station can also be used for Scanner recipes, and is much faster, usually completing them in less than a second.
Quantum Computer
The Quantum Computer is used to produce a new resource called computation, which is required to run the Research Station as well as other future multiblocks such as the Space Elevator . It has a variable length of between 5 and 16, corresponding to between 2 and 24 Computer Racks, each of which can be filled with circuits to generate computation and cooling devices to prevent overheating.
Optimal layouts for the Quantum Computer are shown on its page. The best layout available in UV before Wetware Mainframes is 24 racks with two Cooling Cores and two Tier 3 APUs each, although cheaper ones using Crystalprocessor Mainframes or less racks are also viable if less efficient. Layouts that produce more computation will speed up researches and therefore save on power, as well as allowing more recipes to be researched based on their minimum computation requirements.
Waterline
Like ZPM, UV brings two new steps to the Waterline, one of which is required in the tier and one of which is not required except as an ingredient to the next grade of water. The Extreme Temperature Fluctuation Purification Unit and its associated Grade 5 water are needed to process Americium-Doped Wafers, which are needed for QPIC Wafers for the Mk3 Fusion Reactor. The High Energy Laser Purification Unit and Grade 6 water are not required until UEV when Grade 7 water must be made, but since it is a significant improvement over Grade 5, and UHV will require large amounts of wafers, it's generally advisable to make it sooner than that. Grade 6 or above water is also required for the most advanced Beam Line masks.
Fusion Reactor Mk3
A Mk3 Fusion Reactor.
Like the previous two tiers, a new Fusion Reactor is the final goal of progression in UV, although it is not as central to said progression as the first two were. It also gets a 2/2 overclock on all Mk2 recipes, and an additional 2/2 overclock on Mk1 recipes as compared to the Fusion Reactor Mk2.
The most notable recipes unlocked by the Mk3 Fusion Reactor are:
- Americium Plasma from Plutonium 241 and Hydrogen, which is immensely faster than the existing Americium recipe: it takes only 3.2 seconds per ingot, compared to 43.2 seconds for the previous recipe in a Mk2 reactor or 21.6 seconds in a Mk3, a speedup of 13.5x or 6.75x; this immense speed increase means it should be the main Americium source as soon as the Mk3 reactor is unlocked, unless meteors or bees are used instead.
- Oganesson, a two-step recipe that first requires Californium from Beryllium and Plutonium 239, with Calcium then added to make Oganesson. It has many uses for recipes later in progression, but its primary uses in UV and UHV are as the best noble gas for Electric Blast Furnace recipes (albeit far too expensive in most cases), where it is 25% faster than Xenon on all recipes that can use it, and for the Void Miner , where it produces 4x as many ores as Xenon.
- Bismuth Plasma, from Tantalum and Zinc Plasma, is used for circuits and soldering starting in UHV, and is the second tier of plasma for the Space Elevator Mining Module.
Some other resources can be produced more easily as well:
- Neutronium can be fused from Americium and Naquadria at 12 seconds per ingot, providing a usable alternative to smelting it, especially if a Compact Fusion Reactor is used.
- Indium can be made from Silver and Lithium, taking 14.4 seconds per ingot.
The "plasma chain" of advanced fusion fuels is finished in the Fusion Reactor Mk3:
- Curium is part of the plasma chain, and is used in an alternate Californium recipe in the future.
- Xenon Plasma, Advanced Nitinol Plasma, and Celestial Tungsten Plasma are the final steps in the plasma chain, producing the best plasma fuel in the game as well as an alternate source of Celestial Tungsten and Advanced Nitinol as materials. Fusing Celestial Tungsten requires Tartarite, so it requires either a Tier 8 Rocket or the Space Elevator in order to reach Tier 8 planets.
Finally, there are a few new materials with no uses until later:
- Silver Plasma is used in UHV for a new plastic, Radox Polymer.
- Rubidium, Nickel Plasma, and Iron Plasma have no uses until UEV.
Compact Fusion
Compact Fusion Reactors are much larger fusion reactors that have roughly the production capacity of 64 standard reactors for the cost of 48. All five tiers of Fusion Reactor have Compact equivalents, but the Mk3 is the first one that is generally considered worth making. The Compact Fusion Reactor is fast enough to use for on-demand fusion recipes, in addition to being an immense upgrade for any passive fusion recipes with sufficiently high demand to justify it.
Cosmic Neutronium
Cosmic Neutronium is a material that plays a similar role in UHV as regular Neutronium does in UV, being used for almost every component as well as for the superconductor. However, unlike regular Neutronium, it cannot be mined directly from planets until the Mothership ; it can be mined by the Space Elevator , but only with a Mk2 module, requiring significant progress in UHV first. The main way to produce it is instead by centrifuging Black Plutonium Dust. On average, 101 Black Plutonium is required per ingot of Cosmic Neutronium. Since both centrifuging and smelting is slow, it is highly recommended to make both steps passive, similar to Neutronium.
Meteors
Another option for players with enough magic progress is meteors , specifically the UV Crop Synthesizer meteor, which is unlocked with UHV circuits. If boosted with Orbis Terrae, this meteor contains around 2000 Cosmic Neutronium Ore when mined with Arcane Bores or manually, and triple that if an Ore Drilling Plant is used instead. By summoning them repeatedly, it's possible to amass very large quantities before getting access to the ore through the Space Elevator. The meteor also has other very useful ores, including a similar amount of Americium Ore, as well as Infinity Catalyst Ore, which can be used for earlier access to Infinity.
Infrastructure Improvements
Power
UV is the point at which power generation from the early game falls off: Nitrobenzene, Rocket Fuel, and Nuclear Reactors can last up to this point, but should be replaced by the start of the next tier. Plasma or Naquadah Fuel, both of which are viable in UV and able to scale for multiple more tiers, should be used instead. Plasma gains access to the Fusion Reactor Mk3, which provides both access to the best plasma chain fuels and an overclock on earlier fusion recipes to reduce the need for spam, and the Stocking Input Hatch helps parallelize on slower fusion steps. It also benefits from new better turbine materials, such as Cosmic Neutronium. Naquadah Fuel also benefits from these improvements for its slow fusion step, and gains access to Haumea Void Miners , the Space Elevator, and the Mega Apiary to help source its inputs.
Stocking Input Hatch
The GUI of a Stocking Input Hatch.
The Stocking Input Hatch is an extremely powerful tool for automation that is unlocked with Neuro Processing Units and UV Electric Pumps. It functions identically to the non-advanced Stocking Input Bus, except that it works with fluids instead of items. It can be used to parallelize passive machines using fluids, such as Fusion Reactors , or to move fluids into passive machines more quickly, but it also has many applications for on-demand crafting. It can be used in concert with Advanced Stocking Input Buses to automate large arrays of multiblocks with recipes that require fluids, using a subnet to allow them to all access the same inventory of fluid, at the cost of being limited to only 16 fluids that must be configured manually. Stocking Input Hatches also have the ability to send 2.1 GL per tick to a multiblock, helping to avoid recipe switching bottlenecks with extremely fast machines like the Mega Chemical Reactor when AE2 cannot push items into them fast enough.
Mega Alloy Blast Smelter
The Mega Alloy Blast Smelter (MABS) is a mega version of the Alloy Blast Smelter that can be made as soon as the player has UV Energy Hatches. Like other mega multiblocks, it has 256 parallels, support for multi-amp hatches, and support for laser hatches with UV-tier glass or better. It also has tiered coil and glass blocks, the former providing speed and energy bonuses, and the latter being used to determine the maximum recipe tier. The MABS should be a priority upgrade both for the immense speed increases it provides to ABS recipes, which are otherwise often very slow and near-impossible to speed up effectively, as well as for its ability to tierskip by using glass tier instead of energy hatch tier to determine its maximum recipe tier.
Component Assembly Line
The Component Assembly Line (CoAL) is a new multiblock for assembling components, such as Electric Motors, Robot Arms, and Sensors. It provides a 25% discount on both resources and time, as well as skipping the Assembly Line , two incredible advantages that mean it should be the only source of components whenever it can be used. The main cost of the CoAL is the 43 tiered Component Assembly Line Casings that determine the maximum available tier of components: a full CoAL takes 688 Electric Motors, 430 Electric Pistons, and 344 Robot Arms of its tier. In UV, both the UV and ZPM CoAL tiers are viable. The ZPM CoAL doesn't help with UV components, but it is much cheaper than the UV CoAL, and still useful for LuV and ZPM superconductors in particular, which are used for Fusion Reactor coils and Wetware Mainframes. The UV CoAL adds the ability to make UV components, but is very expensive, particularly on Americium, until late in the tier.
UU-Matter
UU-Matter begins to be used for crafting in UV, and will continue to be necessary for the rest of the game, particularly for circuits, nanites, and the Space Elevator. In order to obtain it in large quantities, the new Matter Fabrication CPU should be used once the player has a Quantum Anomaly to use to craft it. It has a free EU discount compared to its singleblock equivalent, access to parallels in addition to the existing perfect overclock all Mass Fabricators have, and the ability to use multiple Energy Hatches to scale better. It can also be used to produce Scrap and UU-Amplifier, but this is generally not as effective as overclocking more or placing more Matter Fabrication CPUs.
Elemental Duplicator
The Elemental Duplicator is the multiblock version of the Replicator, which can synthesize pure elements directly from UU-Matter. It is unlocked in UV, although it also requires a Quantum Anomaly in its recipe. It is most useful for certain rare elements, such as Oganesson, that are difficult to produce in sufficient quantities with other recipes.
Cheaper Crystal Circuits
The UV Energy Hatch unlocks a cheaper recipe for Crystalprocessors in the Circuit Assembly Line using Crystal SoCs. These SoCs can be made by engraving Crystal Processing Units, but it is far faster to make them from Ce:LuAG instead. There are two machines that can be used for Ce:LuAG: the Vacuum Furnace , which requires a loop, and the Industrial Autoclave , which requires Oganesson for the recipes without a chance of failure. Crystal SoCs will also be required in UHV for that tier's circuits.
Sidequests
Quality of Life
Auto-Taping Maintenance Hatch
The final maintenance upgrade in the game is the Auto-Taping Maintenance Hatch, which infinitely prevents all maintenance issues on multiblocks, without requiring any input at all. It also continuously fixes maintenance issues on connected multiblocks, meaning that it is no longer necessary to conduct maintenance on a multiblock before turning it on. Wallsharing can be useful in order to reduce the number of Auto-Taping Maintenance Hatches required for large arrays of multiblocks, and since there's never a need to access them, they can be placed in inaccessible locations in order to save on useful shared hatch space.
Laser Vacuum Mirror
The Laser Vacuum Mirror is an upgraded laser pipe that can be used to rotate lasers , although merging or splitting them still requires an Active Transformer . It requires UHV circuits as well as Chromatic Glass, the latter being made in a Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver with a Quantum Anomaly as the lens.
Nano Forge and Nano Resin
The Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.
The main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:
- Cerium
- Dysprosium
- Erbium
- Europium
- Gadolinium
- Holmium
- Lanthanum
- Lutetium
- Neodymium
- Praseodymium
- Promethium
- Samarium
- Terbium
- Thulium
- Ytterbium
Space Elevator
A Space Elevator.
The Space Elevator is a modular multiblock that can be made late in UV, after obtaining UHV circuits. Although it supports many different modules with various abilities, the only one obtainable in UV is the first tier of Space Mining Module, which can produce hundreds or thousands of ores per second using a non-consumed tiered mining drone, computation from a Quantum Computer , rods and drill tips of varying materials depending on the mining drone, and Helium, Bismuth, or Radon Plasma. It can also be configured to change the available ores and modify the chances of each ore being produced. Using the Space Elevator effectively requires robust ore processing, including any processing lines like the Platline or Naqline whose inputs come from ores, and sufficient automatic production of plasma and rods/drill tips of the relevant material. Although it is available in UV, it is expensive enough and available late enough in the tier that many players do not build it until UHV.
The Space Elevator can also be used to travel to any planet up to Tier 8, although it cannot be used to return, so it's necessary to bring a rocket or other means of teleportation to get back. This mechanic can be used to reach Tier 8 planets without the Tier 8 Rocket, and thereby gain earlier access to materials like Awakened Draconium and Infinity Catalyst. An upgrade to Tier 3 motors unlocks travel to Tier 9 planets in UIV.
Mega Apiary
The Mega Apiary is the endgame solution to using bees for resource generation. It can fit thousands of bees, each with the equivalent of 64x acceleration and 8 production upgrades, and guarantees perfect conditions for all of them at once. There are also a few bees that can only produce anything when inside the Mega Apiary. The most notable of these bees in UV are the Americium Bee, the Xenon Bee, and the Drake Bee (which requires the Mega Apiary for Awakened Draconium, but not regular Draconium). It also makes it very easy to scale production, thanks to its Swarmer mode that produces duplicate princesses from a queen infinitely and the fact that it will never kill ignoble bees.
Neutronium Compressor
The Neutronium Compressor is a multiblock that is used to make Infinity Catalyst and Singularities. It has no uses until UHV for most players, but is available in UV, and can be used to get early Infinity for various quality of life upgrades and an improved PCB Factory for players using meteors or the Space Elevator for early Infinity Catalyst.
Kevlar
Kevlar is a fiber that can be made in UV; it has an infamously complex production chain, of similar complexity to the entire Platline . It is not necessary until the Mothership in late UHV, but it can be used before that in the PCB Factory for better speed and resource efficiency compared to PBI. Many players instead opt to use the Kevlar Bee , which produces Kevlar Nuggets in the Mega Apiary, for the small amount of Kevlar that is required until the line can be skipped with the tier 4 Quantum Force Transformer .

documents.text:
Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) is the ninth electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. It unlocks Bioprocessors, infinity ingots, and Draconic Evolution. The overall goal is the construction of the Mothership and Shuttle rocket to reach the Amun-Ra system, which is required to get your foot through the door of UEV . In UHV, many previously optional processing chains and multiblocks become necessary for progression.
Progression
Tier 8 Rocket
This is the last regular rocket upgrade. Tier 8 plate ingots need two UHV energy hatches in the assembly line. The rocket unlocks multiple exoplanets. There is no new dungeon, the Shuttle Rocket schematic can be crafted using a schematic from a Pluto dungeon.
- T Ceti E is required for seaweed, which is used for the new circuit line. A few stacks might be needed to extract the culture.
- Barnarda C is the only source of Unknown Liquid before UEV, and the trees are needed to manufacture Xenoxene.
- Vega B has Infinity Catalyst as a small ore, although meteors are an alternative that is available slightly earlier.
- Barnarda F has Bedrockium as a small ore. While not strictly required, it is a good source for the required large-scale production.
Awakened Draconium can be found as a small ore on four of the new planets, including Vega B and Barnarda F. Tartarite (used to produce Celestial Tungsten plasma) can be found on Barnarda C and Alpha Centauri Bb.
Infinity
Infinity Ingots are crafted in the Dire Crafting Table. Infinity Catalyst has two crafting recipes, the sane option uses the Neutronium Compressor . Besides the new catalyst, this also increases the demand for Diamonds, Nether Stars, and Cosmic Neutronium massively.
Infinity Ingots are used in a large range of quality of life improvements like overclocking the PCB Factory , unlimited energy for AE2, a wireless cross-dimensional AE2 terminal, an infinite oxygen tank and more. They are also used to make the Neutron Collector, an Avaritia block that, when combined with World Accelerators , can supply Cosmic Neutronium before the Space Elevator is able to mine it.
Infinity is required in moderate quantities for various UHV tasks, but gets used in large quantities starting in UEV.
Bio Circuits
Bio circuits are the UHV circuit line, going from ZPM to UEV, and are required for many advanced machines in UHV and almost everything in UEV. Just like Wetware circuits, they rely heavily on the Bacterial Vat and use the Assembly Line for UHV and above circuits. The Bio Lab is again required to produce the cultures used in the Bacterial Vat recipes, although these cultures are much slower and have much lower rates than those used for Wetware, encouraging the player to parallelize across multiple Bio Labs to obtain them more quickly.
Similar to Raw Growth Catalyst Medium, there are three recipes for Raw Bio Catalyst Medium. Generally, the best one is the one that uses tiny piles of Infinity Catalyst Dust; it is cheaper on materials and faster than the Tritanium Dust recipe, but avoids the difficult-to-automate loop in the Biocells recipe. Bio Catalyst also requires Seaweed Extract, which is made using another Bacterial Vat recipe for Seaweed Broth, and requires Unknown Liquid pumped from Barnarda C. The culture for this recipe is initially made using Seaweed harvested from T Ceti E, which can be used to make more seaweed for more cultures if needed.
Similar to Wetware circuits, the many slow machines required to produce Bio circuits leads most players to only use them for UEV circuits, where they are required, and stick with lower tier circuits for everything from ZPM to UHV.
Xenoxene and Radox
Xenoxene is a new fluid that is produced in the Bacterial Vat using Oil, Osmium, and Antimony Trioxide, and is required for both the new Optical SMDs and for the final plastic in the game, Radox Polymer. Obtaining the cultures for Xenoxene is infamously difficult, requiring many different slow and low-chance recipes in sequence, and since multiple cultures are needed to run enough Bacterial Vats to obtain enough Xenoxene for lategame, many players opt to passive said cultures.
Radox is made by combining Barnarda C Wood and Xenoxene in an Industrial Coke Oven , and processing the produced Raw Radox through the Dangote Distillus or Mega Distillation Tower and the Mega Oil Cracker . The Radox Gas made through this process is combined with Oxygen and Titanium Plasma in a Mega Chemical Reactor to make Radox Polymer itself, but another output, Super Heavy Radox, is also needed in late UEV for Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid, a lategame Lubricant replacement.
Radox itself is not required until the Mothership , although it could be used as the best PCB Factory plastic. It gains more uses later on, such as crafting Naquadah Fuel Mk-V, and millions will be needed before the line can be skipped with a tier 4 Quantum Force Transformer in UMV.
ExxonMobil Upgrade
Rugged Botmium casings, the final casing tier, are required to produce Mutated Living Solder, a replacement for Molten Indalloy 140 in soldering that is used for circuits starting at Bio, components starting at UEV, and many other lategame recipes.
Quantum Anomaly
Quantum Anomalies can be made in the Cyclotron . They require two consecutive low-probability steps to succeed, but do not get consumed in many applications. The quest book requires them for Botmium casings, but Molten Advanced Nitinol can alternatively be produced from Advanced Nitinol Plasma from a fusion reactor.
The default layout of a mothership
Mothership
The Mothership is the end of UHV progression, being required to reach Tier 9 planets and obtain Tengam, the magnetic material in UEV through UMV motors. Creating a Mothership requires launching a Shuttle Rocket while holding the necessary blocks and items, similar to a space station. The Shuttle Rocket's schematic is not found in a dungeon like previous schematics, but is instead crafted in the Assembly Line. Once the Mothership is built, engines must be placed on it and provided with fuel to travel to the Amun-Ra system, which contains the six Tier 9 planets; the only relevant to unlock UEV is Seth, which contains Tengam, as the Space Elevator is a better source of everything else on these planets. A small amount of dilithium from Neper is useful early in UEV. The Space Elevator can be used to travel to them, but only after obtaining MK-III motors, which require the DTPF. The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar.
Infrastructure Improvements
Power Production
The only viable power sources in UHV are Plasma and Naquadah Fuel.
The Tier 8 Rocket provides access to Tartarite, meaning Celestial Tungsten Plasma, the best plasma fuel in the game, is available. Plasma also benefits from new rotor materials, such as Infinity Catalyst or Infinity, that significantly improve the amount of power that can be produced from a single turbine. Compact Fusion Reactors become much more affordable in UHV as well, making Plasma significantly easier to scale.
Naquadah Fuel gains access to the Naquadah Fuel Refinery once Bio Circuits are made. This multiblock is used to produce all tiers of Naquadah Fuel above Mk2, each of which is a significant upgrade over its predecessor. Naq3 provides over 4x the EU/t when compared to Naq2, at the cost of somewhat more Heavy Naquadah Fuel and some additives; it can also be doubled by using the Chromatic Glass recipe, but this requires large amounts of Hyper-Intensity Laser Engravers to support. Naq4 is also possible to make in UHV, if either Nano Resin, Meteors, or Depleted Thorium Fuel are used to source the Praseodymium.
UHV Capacitor
The UHV Capacitor is a major upgrade to power storage, providing effectively unlimited EU capacity and removing issues with the EU buffer size being too small to last through large crafts. This does mean that power production is likely to run 24/7, so players need to ensure their power and resource production can handle this. It also unlocks wireless EU between LSCs, but this is not advisable in UHV: any LSC with a UHV capacitor on wireless mode can only safely sustain 10B EU/t of output, significantly less than many multiblocks are likely to consume.
Electric Implosion Compressor
A Tier 1 Electric Implosion Compressor
The Electric Implosion Compressor works similar to the Implosion Compressor , but uses a small amount of energy instead of TNT, in addition to having faster recipes and support for TecTech energy hatches. While not strictly required, this should be built before the Tier 8 rocket.
Component Assembly Line
A UV Tier Component Assembly Line
The UHV Component Assembly Line (CoAL) is very useful due to how often UHV components are used, particularly for UHV superconductors in Bio Mainframes, Compact Fusion Reactor Mk4s, and new multiblocks like the Integrated Ore Factory. Its extremely high Cosmic Neutronium cost makes it very difficult to afford prior to the Mk2 Space Elevator Mining Module, although sufficient investment into Meteors can also be used. Players who have not made any Component Assembly Line yet should make one in UHV.
Integrated Ore Factory
The Integrated Ore Factory is a large-scale ore processing multiblock that is unlocked with UEV circuits. It is able to process thousands of ores per second, and can do every step of ore processing in one machine, making it much faster, more scalable, and more performant than previous ore processing setups. Even with these benefits, it can often struggle to keep up with high-tier Space Elevator mining modules, requiring parallelization, overclocking with 2, 8, or even 32 energy hatches, or both. The IOF should be the only ore processor in lategame bases.
Compact Fusion
Compact Fusion Reactors (Compacts) are advanced versions of Fusion Reactors that condense 64 regular Fusion Reactors worth of throughput into a single multiblock with the cost of 48 Fusion Reactors of their tier. Although Compacts are available as early as LuV, UHV is where regular Fusion Reactors become largely obsolete due to how much the demand for fusion products increases.
Fusion Reactor Mk4
The Mk4 Fusion Reactor is available in UHV, although it is not necessary for any recipes until UEV. Its primary advantage over previous tiers of Fusion Reactor is speed: unlike Mk2 or Mk3 Fusion Reactors, Mk4+ Fusion Reactors get 4/4 overclocks on recipes below their tier. This is still much slower than a Compact Mk3 when using the regular Mk4 Fusion Reactor, but the Compact Mk4 is a massive speed upgrade, ranging from 8 to 21 times as fast as a Compact Mk3 depending on the recipe tier.
The new recipes unlocked, other than a faster recipe for Molten Californium, are all for new materials: Fermium and Neptunium are used for the QFT , Rhugnor is mostly used for Hypogen, Hypogen is better produced through a loop in the DTPF , Metastable Oganesson is used for the Mk5 Fusion Reactor, Technetium Plasma is used in the Space Elevator, Bromine Plasma processes Europium and Americium combs, and Flerovium has almost no uses until UMV.
Space Elevator
Space Mining Module MK-II
The Mk-II space mining module is much more powerful than Mk-I, providing a significant speed improvement and access to many more asteroids with important materials. Most notably, it is an immensely better source of Cosmic Neutronium and Infinity Catalyst than anything available prior, and the only viable source for the quantities needed in UEV. It requires UEV circuits and at least Mk-II motors for the Space Elevator.
Space Assembler Module
The Space Assembler is used to craft certain items that cannot be made in conventional assemblers. Its most notable uses are for Optical Circuits in UEV, but it can be used to craft some quality of life upgrades in UHV, most notably the Advanced Stocking Input Hatch.
Infinite Fluid Drilling Rig
The Infinite Fluid Drilling Rig is the best source of pumpable fluids available until the Space Elevator Pumping Module in UEV. It is much faster than the finite Fluid Drilling Rigs, and has no risk of running out; pumping fluids like Oxygen, Nitrogen, and Fluorine with the Infinite Fluid Drilling Rig can effectively replace existing methods of obtaining those fluids. Like many other infrastructure upgrades in UHV, it is unlocked with UEV circuits.
Sidequests
Creative Items
Infinity Ingots can be used to unlock various Creative items, providing major improvements in quality of life. Most of them are made in the Dire Crafting Table.
- The Infinity Booster Card can be combined with an AE2 Wireless Terminal to allow it to work at any distance and across dimensions.
- The Infinite Oxygen Supply provides unlimited oxygen while in space, useful for travelling on your Mothership.
- The Neutronium Energy Cell provides infinite energy to an AE2 network, and variants exist to integrate it into an ME Controller or Cable Anchor. In addition to simplifying logistics, the Neutronium Energy Cell reduces lag caused by propagating power across networks, and so should be a priority upgrade.
- The Magical Memory provides 65 MB of RAM when placed in an OpenComputers device, and is also used later to craft the Dyson Swarm Ground Unit .
- The Blood Orb of Armok provides infinite LP to a Soul Network.
- The Akashic Records give large amounts of Thaumcraft research points.
- The Crystal Studded Cosmic Neutronium Wand is a wand with unlimited vis.
- The Infinity Egg gives lots of altar power to a Witchery Altar , and improves the Dragonblood recipe in the DEFC .
- The Asgardandelion and Everlasting Guilty Mana Pool both produce infinite Botania mana, one as a flower and one directly in a Mana Pool. The Creative Mana Tablet provides infinite mana to a player's inventory.
Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter
A tier 1 Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter
The Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter (DEFC) is a multiblock used to craft Draconic Evolution components, in addition to unlocking many better Dragonblood recipes that do not consume Dragon Eggs. It is not required until the Stargate , but makes many quality of life enhancements available before that. Crafting the DEFC requires completing Thaumcraft, Blood Magic, and Botania, making it effectively the endpoint of magic progression. It also needs a Draconic Core Schematic to be able to run its initial recipes, which can be found on Pluto or obtained from a Space Elevator Mining Module Mk3 in UIV.
Old Stargate Trophies
UHV contains the first of four old Stargate quests in the Quest Book . These quests are entirely optional, and require submitting the materials needed to make two stargates in an older version of GTNH in order to complete the quest and receive a trophy. Each quest also provides context about the features available and the history of the Stargate during its version. The UHV old Stargate, also known as the Stargate of Split Origin, corresponds to version 2.1.0.0. Although it is the cheapest of the four old Stargates, it is still incredibly expensive by the standards of UHV. Among other ingredients, it requires 625 Eternal Singularities, 41k Bio Mainframes, 233k Infinity, 5.3M UHV Superconductor, and 2.1M Tritanium. As a result, it is best done in later tiers.

WIP! This page is a Work In Progress . You can help out by adding more information to the page.
Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) is the tenth electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. It unlocks the final circuit line, Optical Circuits, as well as materials like Hypogen and Transcendent Metal. The overall goal is the construction of the Dimensionally Transcendent Plasma Forge (DTPF) which unlocks Transcendent Metal (the UIV tier material) as well as easier recipes for several materials.
The DTPF, the goal of UEV
Progression
Tengam
The first step in UEV progression is using the Mothership to travel to Seth , which is the only planet where Raw Tengam Ore can be found. Raw Tengam is then processed in the Magnetic Flux Exhibitor into Purified Tengam, which is the magnetic material for UEV, UIV, and UMV Electric Motors. Once the player obtains their first Purified Tengam, they can make a Tengam Electromagnet, which greatly speeds up the separation process.
Waterline
Like LuV , ZPM , and UV , UEV brings two new steps to the Waterline , one of which is required in the tier and one of which is not required until the next tier but increases yield of components for optical circuits. The Residual Decontaminant Degasser Purification Unit and its associated Grade 7 water are needed to process Optically Enriched Crystalline Boules to make UIV circuits. After making the DTPF , the Absolute Baryonic Perfection Purification Unit and its Grade 8 water and Stabilised Baryonic Matter can increase the yield of raw optical enhanced chips by 2.25x per boule over Grade 7, and are required for Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid, which is used in many recipes beginning at UIV.
The Degasser, used for grade 7 water
Optical Circuits
Optical Circuits are the final circuit line, going from UV to UIV, and are required for advanced machines in UEV as well as everything in UIV and above; UMV and UXV circuits are made from Optical Mainframes, although they are not themselves part of the Optical circuit line. Optical Processors, the UV circuit, are the slowest Circuit Assembly Line recipe in the game, and will be the vast majority of the player's CALs in the endgame; the remaining three circuits in the line all require the Assembly Line and have very slow recipes, encouraging players to scale Advanced Assembly Lines to meet the circuit demand.
Optical circuits require many new materials and machines to make. Optical SMDs, which were optional for Wetware and Bio circuits, are mandatory for Optical ones, introducing a requirement for Xenoxene and many new foils of different materials. Optical Processors require Optically Compatible Memory and Optically Perfected CPU, which are made in the Space Assembler ; both of them have three different recipes, with better recipes requiring higher-tier materials and Space Assemblers but being faster to produce. Finally, they require Raw Exposed Optical Chips, which need Grade 7 or Grade 8 water as well as a Tier 2 Nano Forge .
The many slow recipes involved in making Optical circuits, especially those in the Space Assembler, leads most players to avoid using them for circuits below UIV at first, although doing so becomes more viable with better recipes as well as higher tier Space Assemblers.
Dimensionally Transcendent Plasma Forge (DTPF)
The DTPF is the endpoint of UEV progression, and will be central to progression for the rest of the game. Crafting the DTPF requires Optical Mainframes and Eternal Singularities, but is otherwise not particularly expensive. However, the casings used in the DTPF require UIV power in the Assembly Line, meaning they cannot be crafted in an Advanced Assembly Line yet; parallelizing multiple Assembly lines is necessary to be able to craft them in a reasonable amount of time.
The DTPF uses heating coils, similar to multiblocks like the EBF , to determine the recipes it can run. In UEV, the only heating coil tiers that are available and allow any recipes are Awakened Draconium and Infinity. Awakened Draconium coils can be used to make Cosmic Neutronium much cheaper, as well as Infinity with robust fuel production, but Infinity coils are needed to make Tesseracts, Hypogen, and Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid, all of which are needed for further progression.
Once the DTPF is operational, it can be used to make many key materials much faster, much more cheaply, or both: the aforementioned Cosmic Neutronium and Infinity, as well as Neutronium, Bedrockium, Chromatic Glass, and LuV-UV Superconductor Base, with Awakened Draconium coils, and UHV Superconductor Base and Hypogen are added with Infinity coils. Hypogen is needed in UIV for the next coil upgrade, and should be a priority; the DTPF Hypogen recipe is much faster than the Fusion Reactor one, in addition to being eight times cheaper on Infinity.
Fueling the DTPF
Almost all recipes in the DTPF require a fuel, known as a catalyst, in order to run. There are five tiers of catalyst, known as Crude, Prosaic, Resplendent, Exotic, and Stellar, but only the first four are available until the Eye of Harmony in UMV . Crude catalyst requires four plasmas made in the Fusion Reactor , Helium, Iron, Calcium, and Niobium, and the next three tiers add four more plasmas each: Radon, Nickel, Boron, and Sulfur for Prosaic, Nitrogen, Zinc, Silver, and Titanium for Resplendent, and Americium, Bismuth, Oxygen, and Tin for Exotic; higher tiers of catalyst also require all the plasmas used by all previous tiers.
In UEV, the only way to make catalyst for the DTPF is through very slow recipes in the Industrial Mixing Machine and Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver ; due to how slow these processes are, and the amount of catalyst required, both the plasma production and the mixing should be run passively. In UIV , the Transcendent Plasma Mixer (TPM) can be used to immensely speed up catalyst mixing, but it requires materials from the DTPF as well as 2048 kL of each of the first four types of catalyst to craft. The DTPF builds up a discount on catalyst usage during continuous operation, up to 50% after 8 hours, which is very useful for stretching catalyst further before the TPM.
Fusion Reactor Mk4 and Mk5
The Fusion Reactor Mk4, which was optional in UHV , becomes required in UEV for the QFT and progressing the DTPF. Hypogen is much faster and more efficient to make in the DTPF, but the first DTPF recipe available is a loop that requires one ingot worth of Molten Hypogen to start, meaning the Mk4 Fusion Reactor is unavoidable to begin the loop. Neptunium Plasma and Fermium Plasma are required to craft QFT casings, and Hypogen is also used for the catalysts used in every QFT recipe. Neptunium, Fermium, Metastable Oganesson, and Rhugnor are all required to make the Mk5 Fusion Reactor, which is itself not required until UIV.
The Compact Mk4 is very useful, and should be preferred over the regular one if at all possible. It is much faster than previous tiers of Compacts, due to getting 4/4 overclocks instead of 2/2 overclocks on every recipe, and the many slow Mk4 recipes make its 64 parallels on Mk4 recipes very useful for crafting a QFT or Mk5 Fusion Reactor.
The most useful recipe in the Mk5 Fusion Reactor is Plutonium 241 Plasma, the best Space Elevator plasma, which is fast enough that a single regular Mk5 Fusion Reactor can support almost a dozen Mk2 Space Mining Modules. The other recipes are less useful in UEV. Fermium Plasma and Neptunium Plasma have much faster recipes, although when comparing a Compact 4 to a regular Mk5 they are only around 70% faster. Rhugnor and Metastable Oganesson have improved recipes as well, but both require a Godforge , which is well into UIV. Lead Plasma and Thorium Plasma are primarily used for the best DTPF catalyst, which requires an Eye of Harmony and therefore is gated to UMV, and otherwise have no use except processing Europium and Americium combs.
Infrastructure Improvements
Power
Power demands continue to scale in UEV, particularly on Advanced Assembly Lines and after making the DTPF. UEV does not introduce any new ways to generate power, leaving scaling existing ones as the only option, but it does introduce wireless power as a way to improve power transportation.
Generation
Naquadah Fuel and Plasma remain the only viable power sources in UEV. Naqfuel can be upgraded to Mk4, or even Mk5, by using Tier 2 coils in the Naquadah Fuel Refinery and combining Mk3 fuel with various materials. Prior to the DTPF, only the weaker recipes for both fuels are viable, but the DTPF can be used to produce Hypogen and Infinity fast enough to use the stronger recipes, improving the efficiency of Mk3 fuel. Plasma gains access to the Compact 4 to increase fuel production, but Infinity remains the best available rotor material.
UEV Capacitor
The UEV Capacitor has the same storage capacity as the UHV Capacitor, but 100 times the wireless download capacity, being able to download up to 1 trillion EU/t as compared to 10 billion for its predecessor. As a result, it can be used to transport power to distant setups wirelessly, rather than chaining Active Transformers; this greatly increases both the amount of power that can be transported and the ease of doing so.
Space Pumping
The Space Pumping Module is the endgame solution for producing any fluid previously obtained from a Fluid Drilling Rig or Planetary Gas Siphon , as well as a couple new ones like Radon. The Space Pump does not require any inputs except power, can be conveniently located in the player's base, and can be switched to different fluids, either automatically with OpenComputers or manually.
Component Assembly Line
The UEV Component Assembly Line (CoAL) is very useful for the large quantities of UEV Superconductor needed to make Optical Mainframes. However, its very high Infinity cost makes it difficult to afford early in the tier, and many players instead wait until they can use the DTPF for either Cosmic Neutronium or Infinity itself before constructing it. Few multiblocks in UEV itself take large amounts of UEV components, but the UEV CoAL should be built before making a tier 2 QFT or a Compact 5, as both take UEV components in bulk.
Crafting Input Buffers
The Crafting Input Buffer is a variant of the Crafting Input Bus with support for recipes containing fluids, unlocked after completing Grade 7 water. It is the best way of sending recipes to machines in the endgame, due to its infinite buffer, perfect isolation of recipes, and ability to take priority over every other recipe. However, it cannot be parallelized with Crafting Input Proxies until UIV, meaning it can only be used for cases where 1-4 machines, depending on wallsharing, are sufficient; otherwise, advanced stocking or interface P2P should still be used.
Eternal Singularities
Eternal Singularities are an item that is available as early as UHV, but generally not useful until UEV. They are made from 63 different Singularities, created from large amounts of a single material placed in a Neutronium Compressor , that are then combined in a Dire Crafting Table. They have many uses, but the most notable ones are that each DTPF controller requires 4 and that each QFT controller requires 1. Most of the materials should be already accumulated by the player from their Void Miners or Space Elevator , but a few may be difficult. Of particular note is Unstable, which can be obtained from either bees, crafting using a Pseudo-Inversion Sigil, or processing Barnarda E/F Stone Dust. In UIV , an immensely cheaper source of Eternal Singularities is unlocked in the form of the Black Hole Compressor .
Storage
Another use for Eternal Singularities that is available in UEV is various advanced bulk storage options: the Infinity Chest and Digital Singularity cells.
The Infinity Chest has 243 slots, equivalent to a Compressed Chest, but each slot can store 2.1 billion of one item type, not just 64, making it useful for storing large amounts of varied items when combined with a Storage Bus.
Digital Singularity cells, which have variants for items, fluids, and essentia, can store 4.61 quadrillion items/liters/essentia of a single type, making them effectively infinite storage. Because they only support one type, they should always be partitioned before use. In the endgame, Digital Singularities will be the only way to store materials in the quantities produced by multiblocks like the Eye of Harmony , but in UEV they are generally too expensive to be practical.
Quantum Force Transformer
The Quantum Force Transformer (QFT), which is unlocked after Optical Mainframes, is a multiblock that can be used to run many chemical lines in the game in a single step. It can be built either before or after the DTPF, although the large amounts of Quantum Anomalies and DTPF catalyst required may make it difficult to do the QFT first. The skips available with a tier 1 QFT are:
Tier 1 QFT
- Adhesives (Soldering Alloy, Indalloy, Advanced Glue, Super Glue)
- Rubbers (Rubber, Silicone Rubber, Styrene-Butadiene Rubber, Polyphenylene Sulfide)
- Plastics (Polyethylene, PVC, Polystyrene, PTFE, Epoxid, PBI)
- Platinum Line
- Titanium/Tungsten Line
- Thorium/Uranium/Plutonium
The Adhesives recipe is also required to create Hyper-Stable Self-Healing Adhesive, which is used to make the tier 2 QFT. The tier 2 QFT is possible to make in UEV, albeit expensive, and unlocks these skips:
- Monazite Line
- Bastnasite Line
- Cerium-Rich Mixture
- Naquadah
- Enriched Naquadah
- Netherite
- Prismarine
Wireless Data
Optical Mainframes also unlock the Wireless Assembly line Reception Connector and Wireless Data Bank Transmission Connector. These wireless data hatches, unlike conventional data hatches, do not have to be in pairs: any number of Wireless Reception Connectors can pull from a single Wireless Transmission Connector, and vice versa, making them very convenient for setting up the large arrays of Advanced Assembly Lines needed in lategame.
Side Quests
Draconic Evolution
After obtaining Optical Mainframes, it is possible to make the Awakened Core Schematic, and thereby craft Awakened Cores in the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter , which are used to make the top-tier tools, armor, and equipment from Draconic Evolution.
Draconic armor provides many useful movement and utility options, including both vertical and horizontal speed modifiers, inertia cancellation, and built-in Night Vision, in addition to a shield that uses power to prevent all damage. Draconic tools and weapons are less useful, since the tasks they excel at (breaking blocks and dealing damage respectively) can be done in other ways, but are still worth noting.
There are also two other pieces of equipment: the Draconic Flux Capacitor, which stores a very large amount of RF and can charge RF-using equipment like that from Draconic Evolution, and the Enhanced Charm of Dislocation, which can store a large number of destinations and conveniently teleport to them.
Avaritia Equipment
Draconic Evolution equipment is also used to craft Avaritia tools and armor, which requires combining it with a variety of armors or tools from both tech and magic mods.
Infinity Armor provides (almost) complete invincibility with a full set equipped, even to the /kill command, but lacks many of the quality of life features of Draconic Armor. The Sword of the Cosmos can instantly kill anything in a single hit, including bosses like the Gaia Guardian or Chaos Guardian, and even including players wearing a full set of Infinity Armor.
The World Breaker, Nature's Ruin, and Planet Eater are tools capable of mining very large areas at a time, with the World Breaker being especially notable for its ability to break normally unbreakable blocks like Bedrock and its built-in Fortune 10. These features combined allow it to obtain Chaos Shards without actually defeating the Chaos Guardian, and increase the number of shards harvested from 4 to 20.
Old Stargate
UEV contains the second of the four old Stargate trophies, the Stargate of Polychrome Contest, corresponding to version 2.1.2.3qf. The materials required are largely similar to the Stargate of Split Origin in UHV, but in approximately four times the quantity: 625 Eternal Singularities, 167k Bio Mainframes, 964k Infinity, 5.9M Tritanium, and 21M UHV Superconductor, among many others. In addition, many of the parts in the Stargate of Polychrome Contest are very slow UIV Assembly Line recipes, meaning they cannot be run in the Advanced Assembly Line until the next tier.
Not a Noob Certificate
The Certificate of not being a noob anymore, more commonly known as the Not a Noob Certificate, is an optional item tied to a quest in the UEV chapter. Unlocking the quest requires the Killing Evolved quest in the Kill All the Things chapter, which itself requires finishing Twilight Forest and Galacticraft progression. The certificate itself is a very slow Extruder recipe; even an Industrial Extrusion Machine with 8 UEV Energy Hatches will take multiple hours to complete it. Other than completing the quest, the Not a Noob Certificate has no practical benefit.
